title: 第三章 得到了一件巫术道具第四章 我终将超越神明
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
当初前往黑塔巫师学院那漫长而颠簸的路途中，马车厢内弥漫着许多流言。
莫宁总是将耳朵高高竖起，从中提炼各种信息碎片。
其中一件事被新人们反复讨论——上一届新人，总数三百零七人。
两年新人期结束之时，仅有一百五十三人最终成功凝聚灵环，得留在学院继续修炼。
近乎一半的淘汰率，已足够严酷。
但更令人脊背生寒的是后续——未能凝聚灵环的失败者，并非全部得以返回故乡。
登记在册安全离开的，不足九十人。
那么剩下的七十余人呢？
答案是——死了，或者失踪了。
接近四分之一的总死亡率，揭示出了黑塔学院的另一面——这里绝非温情的象牙塔，而是一座机遇与死亡并存的险地。
而此刻。
面对莱特轻描淡写抛出的“探索幽静密林可得奖励”的诱惑，莫宁心中警铃大作。
让一群连最基础巫术都未掌握的纯粹新人，去尝试进入一个二级复合型巫术构筑的秘法厅？
其中的危险性，不言而喻。
莱特只提到奖励，却对风险只字不提，背后必然隐藏着深深的恶意。
这足以证明，人物分析模型的判断非常准确。
莫宁在心底告诫自己：绝对不要相信此人！
他还暗暗警醒：“黑塔学院内的危险并不只是巫术，里面的学徒乃至巫师也很危险，今后必须谨言慎行！”
他偷瞄一眼旁边的新人，在心底叹了一口气。
这些菜鸟依旧盯着树林，满脸向往之色，丝毫没有意识到二级学徒的险恶用心。

莱特似乎很满意自己抛出的“鱼饵”造成的效果，以最后一句话结束了指引。
“好了，我的工作就是将你们从湖畔城堡送到这里，现在工作已经完成了，接下来‘巫灵’会给予你们更具体的引导。”
说完这句话，他做了一个看似随意的动作——右手拇指轻轻拂过腰部，随即手臂向外一挥。
“呼——！”
一大蓬苍白得近乎虚无的火焰，毫无征兆地自他脚下升腾而起。
火焰没有丝毫热度，反而散发着幽幽的冷意，瞬间吞噬了他的袍角，向上蔓延。
“啊——！”
惊呼与尖叫响起，人群下意识地后退。
只见苍白冷焰迅速包裹了莱特全身，他的身影在火焰中扭曲、模糊，仅仅两三个呼吸间便化作一小撮灰白色余烬。
马上有人反应过来。
“应该是巫术！”
“莱特先生离开了。”
就在这时。
一个毫无情绪起伏的机械音，清晰地传入每个人的耳中：
“通告：二级学徒莱特，认证序列号5-091-034，已通过‘瞬影粉’触发传送协议，离开‘幽静密林’秘法厅。
“当前秘法厅内无引导者，新人指引程序由学院‘巫灵’接管，请各位认真听从引导。”
人群立即安静下来。
先前莱特提到过巫灵，所以新人们只是惊讶了一下。
content_en:
On the long and bumpy journey to the Black Tower Wizarding Academy, there were many rumors in the carriage.
Mourning always kept his ears high, extracting various fragments of information.
One of the things was discussed repeatedly by the newcomers - the total number of newcomers in the previous session was 307.
At the end of the two-year rookie period, only 153 people finally succeeded in gathering spiritual rings and had to stay in the academy to continue training.
The elimination rate of nearly half is harsh enough.
But what is even more chilling is the follow-up - not all the losers who failed to gather their spiritual rings can return to their hometowns.
Less than ninety people were registered to have left safely.
What about the remaining seventy people?
The answer is - dead or missing.
The total mortality rate of nearly a quarter reveals another side of the Black Tower Academy - this is by no means a warm ivory tower, but a dangerous place where opportunity and death coexist.
And at this moment.
Faced with the temptation of "exploring the secluded jungle to get rewards" that Wright casually offered, Mourning's alarm bells rang in his heart.
Let a group of pure newcomers who have not mastered even the most basic witchcraft try to enter a secret law hall constructed with a second-level compound witchcraft?
The dangers involved are self-evident.
Wright only mentioned the rewards but said nothing about the risks. There must be deep malice hidden behind it.
This is enough to prove that the judgment of the character analysis model is very accurate.
Moning warned himself in his heart: Never trust this person!
He also secretly warned: "The dangers in Black Tower Academy are not just witchcraft. The apprentices and even wizards inside are also in danger. You must be careful in your words and deeds in the future!"
He glanced at the newcomer next to him and sighed inwardly.
These rookies were still staring at the woods with longing expressions on their faces, completely unaware of the sinister intentions of the second-level apprentices.
Wright seemed to be satisfied with the effect of the "bait" he threw, and ended the guide with the last sentence.
"Well, my job is to send you here from the lakeside castle. Now that the work has been completed, the 'Witch Spirit' will give you more specific guidance."
After saying this, he made a seemingly random movement - his right thumb gently brushed his waist, and then waved his arm outward.
"Huh-!"
A huge flame, so pale that it was almost nothing, rose up from under his feet without any warning.
The flame didn't have any heat at all, but instead exuded a faint coldness, swallowing up the corners of his robe in an instant and spreading upward.
"Ah——!"
Exclaims and screams rang out, and the crowd subconsciously retreated.
The pale cold flames quickly enveloped Wright's body. His figure was distorted and blurred in the flames, and turned into a handful of gray-white embers in just two or three breaths.
Someone reacted immediately.
"It should be witchcraft!"
"Mr. Wright left."
Just then.
A mechanical sound without any emotional ups and downs was clearly transmitted to everyone’s ears:
"Notice: Second-level apprentice Wright, certification serial number 5-091-034, has triggered the teleportation protocol through the 'Instant Shadow Powder' and left the 'Secret Forest' Secret Hall.
"There is currently no guide in the Secret Magic Hall, and the guidance process for newcomers is taken over by the academy's 'Witch Spirit'. Please follow the guidance carefully. "
The crowd immediately fell silent.
Wright had mentioned the Witch Spirit before, so the newcomers were just surprised.
